source.name: East Valley Tribune: Bank One Ballpark renamed Chase Field
source.quote: Chase assumed Bank One's 30-year, $100 million commitment to the Diamondbacks in the merger.

note: Arena naming rights: Chase Field. Chase assumed Bank One's naming-rights commitment when the banks merged; the ballpark was renamed in September 2005. The same article reports Chase commits about $3 million a year, escalating; Ballparks of Baseball reports $2.2 million a year through 2028 (the two disagree).
